turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: For Barcelona, there's a tiny hotel in the old town or a bigger place outside the center with a pool. Same price.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The old town puts you right in the action, but it can be noisy at night. The pool is great in summer, but you'd take the metro in. What matters more to you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I have five seconds to think? Ask me again after.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good point. Just check how close it is to a metro stop, ideally under ten minutes' walk.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. I rent a basement flat. One small north facing window. Can I grow herbs at all?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Some, yes. Mint, parsley and chives handle lower light better than sunny herbs like basil or rosemary.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Basil was the one I wanted, of course.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Of course. You could grow basil under a small clip on grow light. They're cheap now, and it makes a huge difference.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Does it need to be on all day?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: About twelve to fourteen hours. A plug timer makes it effortless.
